# ESP32-S3 upstream refresh A/B at kixel-ai/rind `8a5977ad`, CPU at 240 MHz, second session

Second session of the 240 MHz ESP32-S3 upstream refresh A/B on the same board (MAC ending 3D:C8), 2026-11-23. The tables below are this session's control image; [ab.md](ab.md) has this session's images, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method.

- Board: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 class board, ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, 8 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 3D:C8
- CPU: Espressif ESP32-S3 (Xtensa LX7), 240 MHz
- Toolchain: rustc 1.97.0-nightly (8ea53bcd7 2026-07-08) (esp 1.97.0.0), xtensa-esp32s3-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1
- Control image `ctl`: kixel-ai/rind main 8a5977ad as it is (HACL* Poly1305 in u64 limbs, HACL* ChaCha20; rolled SHA-512 is upstream's default here, #944)
- Control runs: 6 flashes (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 of 11)
